mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (id, vector_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{vectorId}, #{content}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.lambda.fusion.ai.handler.PgVectorHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO ${tableName} (id, vector_id, content, metadata, embedding, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.vectorId}, #{item.content}, #{item.metadata}::jsonb, #{item.embedding, typeHandler=com.lambda.fusion.ai.handler.PgVectorHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, vector_id, content, metadata, (1 - (embedding <=> #{queryVector, typeHandler=com.lambda.fusion.ai.handler.PgVectorHandler})) as score, (embedding <=> #{queryVector, typeHandler=com.lambda.fusion.ai.handler.PgVectorHandler}) as distance FROM ${tableName} WHERE (1 - (embedding <=> #{queryVector, typeHandler=com.lambda.fusion.ai.handler.PgVectorHandler})) > #{minScore} ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT id, vector_id, content, metadata, similarity(content, #{keyword}) as score, (1 - similarity(content, #{keyword})) as distance FROM ${tableName} WHERE content % #{keyword} ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{topK}
